title: Your first customer record: create, save and find it again
goal: Create a customer in your own training infobase, reopen the saved record and distinguish editing it from creating another.

prerequisites.text: Install official training 1C:Enterprise and create a separate empty file infobase. The lab guide covers these steps.
This lab needs no programming, Nexus Studio, source archive or Windows Sandbox. Its route includes preparing the simple catalog.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: A customer calls again. Creating a similarly named customer is easy, but splits history between two cards. Follow one record: enter a name, save, reopen and rename it. Matching text alone does not establish identity; its code and reference help track the saved card.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: Use installed 1C:Enterprise. Designer is needed only to prepare the new empty target; enter cards and requests in the application. Nexus provides explanation, example, reference and your note; it neither transfers records into 1C nor observes unsaved fields. These manual tasks need no BSL or Code Studio.

sections.title: Why a service desk needs a customer catalog
paragraphs: Imagine a dispatcher receiving service requests. Typing each customer name again invites spelling differences and accidental duplicates. A catalog lets you save a customer once and later select that record in requests. We are not creating requests yet: the small goal is a clear customer list with a record you can find after closing its window. All names in the exercise are fictional.

In 1C a catalog defines records of the same kind. Клиенты is the kind of data; «Учебный Север» is one particular catalog item. A developer defines the available properties in Designer. A user fills those properties for a particular item in 1C:Enterprise mode. Creating a catalog definition and entering a customer are therefore different activities in different modes.

A list form displays several customers; an item form, called a customer card in this lesson, displays one. Create (Создать) opens a new card. Double-clicking a saved row opens an existing one. This matters when correcting a name: selecting Create again starts another customer instead of correcting the saved record.

sections.title: Reason before acting
paragraphs: Before saving, you are editing a new card. After Save and close the row is available in the list. Reopening retrieves saved values rather than merely displaying the previous input.
Identify the infobase, list and particular record separately. A command, visible text and saved state are different things.

sections.title: What Code and Description mean
paragraphs: Our simple configuration has the standard Code (Код) and Description (Наименование) attributes. Description is text intended for people; enter «Учебный Север». Code helps distinguish rows. This lab uses automatic numbering, so leave the new code empty and inspect the value assigned when saving. Do not copy another record’s code or assume that every configuration uses the same numbering rules.

A visible field belongs to a form. An attribute is the data property whose value the field helps a user enter. For example, the Наименование field edits the Наименование attribute. The platform can generate forms for this simple catalog, so you need not design an entire window before entering the first record. A later lesson explains custom forms after you understand the user’s required actions.

Text visible in an open new card is not sufficient proof of durable saving. Choose Save and close (Записать и закрыть), wait for the list and check that a row appears. Open it again and inspect the value. Reopening distinguishes saved data from text that was merely displayed in an input. Do not close the entire application immediately after pressing Save without checking its result.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: North is renamed “Training North — repair”. Do its existing requests need a new customer card?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. Editing a saved card changes the display name of that record. The author experiment preserves its code and reference. Create would make another record; an identical name would not turn it into the old one.

sections.title: One record, a new description: avoid an accidental duplicate
paragraphs: A saved item has its own identity. A reference allows the application to point to that item; its displayed description is only a human-readable representation. Open the existing customer, change «Учебный Север» to «Учебный Север — ремонт» and save. You are editing the same card. In this lab confirm that its code is unchanged and no additional list row has appeared.

Create starts a different workflow: a new card becomes a separate record when saved. Calling it «Учебный Север» does not automatically combine it with another customer. Our simple training catalog deliberately does not enforce unique descriptions. Search and compare available attributes before adding a new customer. A real application’s duplicate detection rules are a separate design decision.

Similar row text alone cannot prove reference equality. For now use the observable difference: renaming an existing customer leaves one row with its previous code, whereas creating «Учебный Юг» adds a second row with its own code. Programming with references and documents comes later. This introductory lab requires no GUID inspection or service identifier processing.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: In the customer-list search box enter “Несуществующий учебный клиент” (a deliberately nonexistent training name), then press Enter. Observe an empty list. Select the clear × at the right of the search box: both saved cards must reappear. Search hides rows; it does not delete records.
Cancel the unsaved new card. Double-click the existing row and edit it. If a duplicate was already saved, inspect which record you created; do not delete the original at random.

sections.title: An empty list, search and reopening
paragraphs: An empty visible list does not always mean data loss. You may have opened another catalog or infobase, or retained a search filter. After renaming a customer, searching for its complete old description may no longer match it. Clear the search and inspect the full list. Sorting changes row order; filters change visible membership. Neither action alone creates or deletes customers.

To check saving, close 1C:Enterprise mode and reopen the same training infobase from the launcher. Verify its displayed name and directory. Open Клиенты, clear search and find both rows. Reopen each card. If both descriptions and their separate codes are present, the reopening check has succeeded. Preserve a screenshot containing only the fictional training data.

Nexus provides the route and stores your own completion report. It does not see the external 1C window and cannot automatically confirm that your card appeared. Preserve the actual infobase and observations separately. Use the platform’s .dt dump for backup and another new infobase for restoration checks. Creating a copy must not replace the original training work.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: In your prepared practice create “Training East”, save and reopen it. Record its actual code. Rename that same card to “Training East — service”. Separately create “Training West”. Close and reopen the list, find both records and compare East’s code before and after. Do not rename North from the worked example.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

sections.title: Actual training-service window
paragraphs: The author checked actual CF loading into a new own infobase, saving and renaming customers, 30/45 requests, refusal without Customer and a separate new 20/55 experiment. All four records were compared after restarting; the worked pair is preserved. Three GUI captures show only their labelled states. Learner actions, installer, permissions, training build 1508 and complete manual entry of every form are not verified.

selfcheck.prompt: North is renamed “Training North — repair”. Do its existing requests need a new customer card?
options: No: edit the same record
Yes: the name creates a new reference
Yes: the old card is deleted
selfcheck.feedback: No. Editing a saved card changes the display name of that record. The author experiment preserves its code and reference. Create would make another record; an identical name would not turn it into the old one.

selfcheck.prompt: Where do you enter a particular customer’s description in this lab?
options: In the Name property of the configuration object.
In a new catalog item card in 1C:Enterprise mode.
In the Nexus Studio course selector.
selfcheck.feedback: The Клиенты definition describes the application. A user enters «Учебный Север» in the item card.

selfcheck.prompt: How do you correct the description while keeping the existing record?
options: Open its row, edit the description, save and check that its previous code remains.
Choose Create and enter the corrected description.
Rename the catalog in Designer.
selfcheck.feedback: Editing an existing card preserves its identity. Create starts another record.

selfcheck.prompt: After renaming, searching for the complete old description shows an empty list. What should you check first?
options: Whether the installed platform has stopped working.
Whether the whole configuration needs rebuilding.
Clear search, check the selected infobase and inspect the full list.
selfcheck.feedback: A filter can hide an existing record. Empty visible results do not prove data deletion.

selfcheck.prompt: East has a new name; West looks similar. How do you choose the intended record?
options: Open the intended row and check its code
Use only a similar name
Create a third card
selfcheck.feedback: East had my actual code before editing; renaming the same card preserved it. Reopening shows “Training East — service”. West was created separately, has a different code/reference and its own row. The author’s technical experiment additionally compares references: East before equals East after, and East differs from West. The learner UI exposes the code and reopened values; a name alone does not establish reference identity.

selfcheck.prompt: How did you distinguish the selected record, unsaved input and saved result? Give your own observation and the check’s limit.
selfcheck.feedback: This free response is not graded automatically. Compare it with actual fields in your own infobase.
